title_en: You Speak About 16,000 Words a Day #Shorts
desc_en:
People speak about 16,000 words a day, men and women alike. That is almost 6 million words a year and about 350 million over a lifetime, roughly 450 times the length of the Bible.

Source: Mehl et al., Science 2007 (396 participants). Yearly and lifetime totals calculated; King James Bible about 783,000 words.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
desc_ko:
사람은 하루 약 1만 6천 단어를 말하고, 남녀 차이는 거의 없습니다. 1년이면 거의 600만, 평생이면 약 3억 5천만 단어, 성경 450권 분량입니다.

출처: Mehl 외, Science 2007. 연간·평생 값은 계산(킹 제임스 성경 약 78만 단어)
